name: block-puzzle-reels
description: Deterministic Instagram Reels generation for Block Puzzle game using Remotion

scripts.render:day2: npm --prefix my-video exec remotion -- render src/index.ts MyDayTwoReel ../generated_outputs/videos/Day_02_MyDayTwoReel.mp4
scripts.render:day3: npm --prefix my-video exec remotion -- render src/index.ts MyDayThreeReel ../generated_outputs/videos/Day_03_Puzzle_Challenge.mp4
scripts.render:solveit: npm --prefix my-video exec remotion -- render src/index.ts SolveItReel ../generated_outputs/videos/SolveItReel_Puzzle_Challenge.mp4
scripts.render:all: npm run render:day2 && npm run render:day3 && npm run render:solveit
